D.treatment: explicitly frames transferring and adapting digital practice as a competence
D.comparison: general references to transferring pedagogical skill and knowledge across contexts

O.outcome_detail: alignment of institutional competence frameworks with ERT digital competence

cells.quote: Yet, only one university framework explicitly referred to teachers’ transferring and adapting digital practice as a competence. The other six frameworks made more general references to the transfer of pedagogical skill and knowledge across a range of contexts.
cells.note: The study reports a qualitative document-analysis contrast in how explicitly frameworks represented transferability; it does not report a comparative effect or directional outcome.
